strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Jet, did you find Brother?!
I blundered... I lost track of him...
Where could Rom have gone...?
...No idea... Looks like we got totally separated.
But we were lucky to pinpoint
the Gyandlar's mobile fortress. Now then... Jim!
Comms... The normal channels are still being jammed.
I'm sending out a few signals on special channels...
but honestly, I don't know if Londo Bell will notice...
Then we'll do it ourselves...
Seems we've got no choice... Right, Diondra?
Huh?!
Heheheh... You really are a persistent bunch, coming all the way here.
Diondra! You...
You won't get away this time!
Heh, look who's calling who persistent!
That's right! Meddling with Earth over and over!
You dimwits! It's for the treasure, obviously!
I've heard that plenty of times. What I want to know is...
how did you learn that the third planet of the solar system
had something with the same power as the Hyper Libido?
Now that you mention it...
Didn't they hear it from the Bunker?! Jet?
Fleeing Planet Cronos, you joined the space pirates, the Bunker.
But I hear the Bunker's boss, Grand Captain Garimos,
doesn't trust others easily without a hefty reward.
What are you getting at?!
...Meaning something with mystic power like the Hyper Libido...
Earth's Mutron... or more precisely, the Star of La Mu.
Gades knew it existed from the very start...!
And that was the deal... for teaming up... Is that it?!
And what if it was? Lord Gades's orders are my life!
Whatever the reason may be!
Think about it, Diondra.
The power of Mutron, so like the Hyper Libido, a giant plant planet,
the ninja legend of Planet Radorio...
Why does it all converge on that small blue planet...!
The land of beginnings... Why?!
Enough with the complicated talk! Who cares what the treasure really is!
Heheheh... Trying to distract me won't work!
Now, finish them!
Gadessa!
Looks like she's not interested in listening one bit.
...Those stained by greed, blind to the truth... I will cut down...!
...Heh... I lose... Rom Stol...
You didn't lose to me! You lost to your own heart... to yourself!
...Heh, that's the teaching of Tenku Chushin Ken... isn't it... little brother...
Brother?! Then it's true...
...Rom, fighting you... brought back all my memories...
I was being controlled by Gades...
So that man really is Rom's...
Ngh, Gardy... after I raised him like my own child...
he goes and recovers memories he didn't need...
Brother... Is it... really you...?!
Rom... Leina... You've grown strong...
I got to... see you both... Now I can rest easy...
Brother?! Is it really you?!
Brother...!
After all I did... to you two...
Rom... you still call me... your brother...?
Of course! You're still my brother, no matter what...!
Don't cry... Rom. A woman... may cry, perhaps.
That is... the bond of family. But a man must fight...!
Overcome this trial... Rom...!
That teaching... Father's...?!
Yes. ...You are... of Tenku Chushin Ken...
Damn it... Will I never... be of use... to Lord Gades...?
This is the end, Diondra...!
...Heh... Heheheh... Not yet... not yet... I... RAAAAH!
Damn it... Will I never... be of use... to Lord Gades...?
...Heh... Heheheh... Not yet... not yet... I... RAAAAH!
Impossible... Rom Stol... Cronos clan... Why... do you interfere...
To cut down the evil and darkness that plague this universe.
That is who we of the Cronos clan are... and what my master and father,
Kirai Stol, left us: Tenku Chushin Ken and Tenku Shinken.
...Those ones... the role of auditing... this universe... was theirs alone...
...!! Auditing... the universe...? That's...
Does Gades know... about the Einst?!
What do you mean...?! Gades!
Heh... Heheheh... Hahahahaha... Not even knowing that...
you of the Cronos clan... have traveled the universe...?
A reason? Our mission is to guard the universe from unjust power!
You do not know... who gave you... that mission...
Not even Kirai... knew that... I'd wager...
...Our... mission...?
You mean someone set up Rom's fight?!
Heh... The time... will come... And I had finally... come so far...
The time... that will come...
Excellen, what's wrong?!
I wanted to live longer... I wanted to stay young forever...
So I made the criminal group Gyandlar and roamed space for millennia...
But that's over now.
I don't know about this Hyper Libido... but I'll never give you the Mutron...!
...You hold it... in your hands... and even have... one to guard it...
UOOOOOOH!
Too many of them after all... Tch.
Give it up! I'll pay you back for the humiliation on Planet Cronos!
Bring it!
Hm...? Th-This signal is... Uh-oh! Big Sis!
Hey! We're here to help!
Londo Bell...! You've caught up already?!
We've got an excellent operator on our side.
...Thanks.
Hey, you guys okay?
Everyone! We're fine! We're only just getting started!
Much obliged. Heh, we could use a twist like this once in a while.
Once in a while, sure. ...Hm? I don't see Rom anywhere!?
It can't be...!
Rom wouldn't go down that easy. ...Though we did get separated.
Heh, true enough. A man of his skill would never lose to this rabble.
Buuut we still gotta look for him...!
Doesn't look like they'll let us search for him that easily.
We're inside the enemy's mothership fortress... They won't go easy.
Like moths to a flame, as the saying goes.
If we crush Londo Bell here... squashing the rest of the Earthlings
will be child's play.
That's one way to put it. It's your own fortress being invaded, you know?
That's right, you're the ones who've been backed into a corner!
Careful, Tetsuya. ...Nothing's more dangerous than a wounded beast.
Heh, so what if some old hag's wounded!
Why you... Don't you mock me! Get them!
Oh? Seems we touched a nerve.
...Looks like she was sensitive about it.
...That's a touchy subject, huh. Age catches up with everyone, you know?
That's right! With age comes wisdom, with age comes wisdom!
Grrr! Devil Saturn, don't let them get away with this!
You're gonna regret makin' fools of us!
You seem to be struggling... Diondra...!
That's... Gardy...!
And he brought all sorts of friends.
Tch... We are inside the enemy's fortress, after all.
...The Gyandlar's whole force, all lined up, huh...
Gardy! What have you been doing all this time!?
Heh... Rom Stol lives up to his name... He gave me some trouble.
Don't tell me... Rom's...!?
Did you kill him!? Gardy!
...I'd like to say so... but he escaped.
My brother... is alive!? ...Thank goodness...
Hold on, Leina! Rom... Rom would never run from the likes of you!
It's the truth. The proof... is that he hasn't come here!
No way...
There's no way he'd do something like that, right?
Rom... did?
Hohoho... Seems your hopes were misplaced.
Now, Gardy, finish off the rest of them!
I don't need you to tell me. Come, Earthlings...!
My brother...
Whether he really ran or not... there's no way to know for sure,
but he isn't here, that much is a fact. We'll just have to do this ourselves!
Heh, he'll show up soon enough...!
Heroes are supposed to show up when things are at their worst, right?
Just like Tetsuya did that one time.
Here we go!
Ugh, what... is this feeling...
Gardy!? What on earth is wrong with...
Ohh... M-My head... It feels like it's splitting...
(What's wrong with Gardy... Don't tell me his memories are...!?)
What!? Something's wrong with him...!?
Is he... sick?
Ngh... ohh... I'm... I'm... Rom's...
Looks like some kind of system malfunction.
What's wrong!? What on earth... is happening!?
Tch, there were still enemies hiding!
Sending data on the new enemy to all units.
...That size, and that overwhelming presence... What is it!?
E-Everyone... th-that's...!
To think he'd come all the way out to a place like this... Gades...!
Hey now, isn't that guy...
The leader... of the space crime syndicate, the Gyandlar!
Heh heh heh... It's been a while... detestable disciples of Kirai.
And... Londo Bell, was it? The fools who have continually interfered
with every one of our operations...
This looks... really bad...
I never thought we'd end up fighting him here...!
Ugh... uuh... oh...
Useless fool. ...Still, driving off Rom Stol was well done... Now then...
Gades, you even teamed up with the Bunker to come all the way out here...
Let's hear why!
Heh... I'll tell you, as a parting gift for the afterlife.
After you interfered with my seizure of the Hyper Libido...
I left planet Cronos in search of new power...
Heh, so you ran all the way to Earth, huh!
You appear to be an Earthling...
A fool who doesn't even know what sort of place his own planet is.
A fool!? Why you!
(I knew it... There is something... And what ties into it is... the Einst...!)
Mutron... Are you talking about the power of the Star of La Mu!?
...That, like the Hyper Libido... is merely one of the tools...
Tools...? For doing what?
For... moving the universe.
Moving... the universe?
That makes no sense. What on earth...
Whatever it is... power like that is all the more reason to keep it from you.
Even if it costs me my life.
Fools... You are unworthy. Treasures are fit to be owned by those
who know their worth... I shall dispose of you here,
and claim this Star of La Mu at my leisure later...
No one in this universe is worthy or unworthy. Not even you, Gades.
But... no one has the right to threaten the lives of the living...!
That's right... Protecting people from that unjust power... that's...!
To shield the world from darkness, I bring down the hammer of justice!
Brother!
Wow. He's so cool, as always.
Rom, you're safe!?
Everyone was in an uproar saying you ran away from Gardy, you know?
Got anything to say for yourself, Rom?
...I've just destroyed this mobile fortress's engine block.
You can't escape now, Gades!
Impressive, Rom. Now we can corner them.
Now, get ready to pay!
Grr... Rom Stol! How many times must you interfere with me!
Until the ambitions of you Gyandlar are crushed...!
The whole cast is here... Looks like we have to settle this right here.
We'll just have to steel ourselves. Let's go, everyone!
Let's do this!
Alll right, go get 'em, Show!
Momentum alone won't win this!
But without momentum we're done for, too. Anyway... let's do it!
Yeah... I'll damn well do it...!
Ugh... uuh... Rom...!
Gardy... even if you truly are my brother...
I cannot lose this fight...!
Brother...
Gardy! Why would a man of your skill serve under Gades!
Hmph, Rom! Have you come to confuse me!? I am not your brother...
Gaaargh! M-My head...
No! Whether or not you're my brother no longer matters.
Fighting you, I understood... I sense no true evil within you.
Break free of Gades's spell, Gardy!
D-Don't toy with me... Guoooh!
Gardy!
Heh heh heh heh, don't think my spell breaks so easily, brats...!
Just as I thought, he's the one controlling Gardy.
Nuooh! Rom Stol... All of Kirai's disciples are my enemies!
Brother, look out!
Damn! ...Just when we were so close...
Gardy, stop this!
You... You're Rom's sister! Grrr... Stop trying to confuse me!
Gardy, don't give in!
What!? You intend to pity me!?
No! If you really are my brother Gardy...
you should remember the teachings of Tenku Chushin Ken!
The teachings... of Tenku Chushin Ken...?
That's right... A loser is not one who loses to an enemy...
A loser is one who loses to himself!
Th-That teaching is...
Nuguwaaaaagh!!
No! Blast you, girl, meddling where you don't belong!
Hey, Gades is panicking!
In that case, that man really is...
Gardy!
Milady, just a little more!
Gardy, hang in there!! ...Brother Gardy!!
Uoooh...! L-Leina... Rom...
Gardy! Brother Gardy!?
Gardy!
You two... have grown so strong...
Ngh, Gardy... after I raised him like my own child...
he goes and recovers memories he didn't need...
Gardy... Brother!
Brother!!
After all the things I did to you both... Rom...
you would still call me your brother...?
Of course! You're still my brother, no matter what...!
Rom... Leina... Your feelings and the teachings of Tenku Chushin Ken
seem to have freed me from Gades's spell... I've caused you much trouble.
You did it, milady!
That's our Leina!
Blast you, Kirai's brats!
Then I'll dispose of you siblings all at once! Prepare yourselves!
...Hear me! What moves this universe is not the energy of destruction!
It is... the power of creation!
Destruction is the symbol of power... That's just the excuse of the weak!
That's an excuse, Gades!? Those who corrupt hearts with darkness...
I will not forgive them!
It's not just us... For the people of Earth, and all who've suffered
at the hands of the Gyandlar, we can't lose!
Acquired skill "Meditation".
Brother!
Brother!? ...We'd only just found each other again...
and now we're made to kill each other, brother against brother...
Hmm... What a dirty trick...
Useless fool. ...So that is all Tenku Chushin Ken amounts to.
...Say no more, Gades...!
...Hear me! What moves this universe is not the energy of destruction!
It is... the power of creation!
Destruction is the symbol of power... That's just the excuse of the weak!
That's an excuse, Gades!? Those who corrupt hearts with darkness...
I will not forgive them!
...She never managed to reclaim herself... right to the very end...
So it seems...
And she was only being used by Gades...
Sis, was this one being used too...?
Looks like it... Poor thing...
That woman joined the Gyandlar by choice. ...Perhaps this was her fate...
...We won.
What was Gades trying to tell us...?
So... there does seem to be a link between this string of incidents...
(Close... yes... it's close...)
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
That's the end of the Gyandlar, then...
No kidding. That's what the big boss gets for showing up here.
Phew. ...Hm, Leina?
Something even Father didn't know... Our mission...?
Leina, Gades only said that to throw our hearts into confusion...
Those were the words of a desperate man. Don't let it bother you.
Liar! You... You understand, don't you, Brother!?
Maybe even the reason Gades kidnapped Brother Gardy was...!
...The Cronos clan has a long history...
Even I don't know what happened in the past.
But Leina, I feel the answer lies beyond this battle.
Until then... we can't afford to look back.
Master Gardy, don't you know anything about it?
No... Even while he was controlling me, Gades never once trusted me...
That's just like him, I guess.
...Just like with the Campbellians. ...Leaves a bad taste in my mouth.
So in the end, we still don't have any answers...
Hmm... I don't really get what that Gades boss was after, either.
Immortality, huh...
But... it seems that wasn't all. "For when the time comes"?
...He said that's why he needed eternal life...
...Hm!? Master Rom, the temperature in this mothership's core is rising fast!
What!?
Gades must have meant to sink this ship with us aboard as he died...!
Taking us with him, huh. ...We'll talk later! To the Elshank!
We've still... got time to escape, right?
Ruri, how's it look!?
There's time to escape. There's no time to dawdle.
It's nothing but explosions!
Hey hey, this again!?
Are they that desperate to drag down the people who beat them!?
Seems villains are all the lonely type, huh.
Complain once we're out of danger! Everyone, get out of here!
Right... Hm? Seabook, what are you doing? We're evacuating!
Eternal... huh. Iron Mask said that too.
As I said back then... it's just a fairy tale, Seabook.
...In the end, he must have been mistaken... that Gades guy.
Living forever himself, and what Iron Mask talked about,
building a world where spacenoids live on forever...
are two completely different things.
No... maybe they're not so different.
Whether you live forever yourself, or your other self...
that is, your species, lives on without ever dying out...
(Eternal... life... New life... Memories of when I was controlled...
Do I... know something...?)
